messages:
Maya: quick async standup — API edge / routing / rate limits / JWT rotation

Maya: Yesterday: rolled routing-policy v3 to staging, ran smoke script, saw two 429 spikes from long-poll clients.
Maya: Today: will monitor canary, coordinate with @Arun on rate-bucket tweak for streaming endpoints.
Maya: Blockers: need a quick CR review on gateway-rate-policy change (PR #4503) and a short maintenance window for jwt-key rotation.

Arun: looked into the 429s — seems like continuous batching + burst_window mismatch. Propose lowering burst_capacity for streaming routes 500 -> 250. Draft change: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4503/files
Arun: I'll push a canary patch in ~10m.

Jess: I can review PR #4503 after standup. Also running routing-fallback evals — noticed header-preserving path deviates on 1% of requests :thinking:

Tom: FYI infra saw config drift on edge-proxy fleet; some pods missed the new ratelimit config due to a stuck rollout. I restarted the daemonset and re-triggered config-sync.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: routing-policy v3 -> edge-pool-canary (5 nodes). Monitor: https://deploys/redwood/deploy/2204512345

Maya: @Jess ping on the CR — if you can LGTM I'll cut the canary. Also propose JWT rollover window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Any objections?

Arun: 02:00-03:00 UTC works for services. I'll schedule KMS rotation with security and add transient_key flag to runtime.

Jess: left one nit in PR about metric name (gateway.request.rate -> gateway.requests.count). Fix that and I'll approve.

Tom: No objections to rotation window. I'll watch for spikes during rollout and have rollback playbook ready.

Maya: plan: cut canary in 10m, monitor 30m, promote to 25% if healthy. Rollback criteria: any sustained 5xx or >10% sustained drop in QPS. Will post status here. :rocket:

Jess: LGTM (pending metric name change).

Arun: :eyes:

Tom: :raised_hands:

Maya: quick config snippet I'm going to apply to canary for streaming routes (lower burst):
```
rate_limit:
  unit: second
  requests: 1000
  burst_capacity: 250
  window: 10s
```

Maya: (10m later) Canary started — deploy-bot reports successful. Monitoring at +5m looks stable, continuing to watch.

deploy-bot: Canary success — edge-pool-canary metrics summary: 2xx 99.7%, 429 0.3%, latency p95 210ms.

Maya: created follow-up ticket INF-789 for long-poll bucketing improvements and added test cases for header-preserve path. Thanks all.

Tom: I'll follow up with a short runbook note about the daemonset drift root cause.

Arun: I'll schedule the KMS rotation and post the window in #security-calendar.

Jess: closing loop on CR once metric name changed.

Maya: done — moving to watch stage, will update post-rollout. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
